speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry is considering reviewing the household income and per capita income criteria for ComCare assistance in view of rising inflation against a backdrop of slower economic growth.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Rather, our SSOs assess the needs of individuals and families holistically and exercise flexibility as needed to provide the necessary financial assistance and community support.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Building an inclusive and caring society is a collective effort.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The community plays an important role in partnering the Government in helping those in need.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: If anyone encounters a neighbour, friend or family member who needs support, they can call the ComCare hotline at 1800-222-0000 or refer them to the nearest SSO or Family Service Centre for assistance.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I think the Minister mentioned the last time it was reviewed was in 2019.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Is the Minister exploring other ways of reducing the time lag between the review and cost of living increases for our lower-income households?

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The second supplementary question is: for the short- and medium-term assistance periods, can the Ministry consider extending the periods to reduce the anxiety for many of our lower-income families?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: The period concerned is not critical because it is just a guideline for us to set for our staff in order to qualify and, when they do not qualify, to look at other reasons how to bring them over if they need help from the community or the Government.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
text: It is whether the period of assistance can be extended to reduce anxiety because most of our residents do feel that three months sometimes is very short, and they are very concerned about extensions.
